      <tns:TransferRequest channel="?" version="2">
         <tns:from>?</tns:from>
         <!--nillable:-->
         <tns:to>?</tns:to>
         <tns:amount>
            <common:amount>0.0</common:amount>
            <common:currency>USD</common:currency>
         </tns:amount>
         <!--Zero or more repetitions:-->
         <tns:memo>?</tns:memo>
         <!--Optional:-->
         <tns:scheduled>2024-01-01T00:00:00Z</tns:scheduled>
         <!--You have a CHOICE of the next 3 items at this level; first branch emitted: otp | token | biometric-->
         <tns:otp>?</tns:otp>
         <tns:priority>NORMAL</tns:priority>

   </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>
